race.comment: New Joe Pride acquisition BRIGHTBURN (11) is back for a second campaign after showing tremendous promise in the maiden prep. Stalked the leader then proved too good in the latest appearance on 31 December 2025 over today's journey at Gosford. J Mac doesn't ride too many for this stable but the strike rate sits at 26%. Can kick things off in a big way. AIRWORTHY (2) resumes with blinkers on for the first time. Best of three runs last prep was when resuming over 1250m at Canterbury, beaten under a length. Chances enhanced if the track is wet. MASTER YODA (3) came with a powerful finish to just get up in time at his latest appearance over 1200m at Kembla. Has only raced five times so there is plenty of upside. SEEIAYE (6) is a talented three-year-old back from an 18-week spell. Won a recent trial at Rosehill by panels which is a promising sign. READY FORCOCKTAILS (9) is a talented and lightly-raced mare back from a 20-week spell. Sure to be up for this.
